df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness']).copy()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness','soil_moisture']).copy()
m = smf.ols('species_richness ~ soil_moisture + C(region)', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3:", m.params['soil_moisture'], m.pvalues['soil_moisture'])
# without region
m2 = smf.ols('species_richness ~ soil_moisture', data=d).fit()
print("no region:", m2.params['soil_moisture'], m2.pvalues['soil_moisture'])
# region balance
print(d.groupby('region')['soil_moisture'].mean())
